last_sync.summary: Attribution and provenance housekeeping only. The Capoworks firmware repository now credits Giacomo di Ciocco as author of Capoworks-specific contributions, adds a source-file attribution policy, and corrects the EMP pump file headers. No firmware behavior, configuration, tune format, build option, or flashing procedure changed, so no wiki page needs updating.

decisions.rationale: Adds a contributor credit to the repository README, a new AGENTS.md attribution policy, and Doxygen file/author headers to existing source files. No firmware behavior, configuration field, tune layout, build option, or flashing step changed, so no driver, tuner, or builder action is required.
evidence: README.md: adds 'Author of Capoworks-specific contributions: **Giacomo di Ciocco**.' under Credits
AGENTS.md: new project-scoped source attribution policy for future first-party files
firmware/controllers/sensors/hella_opst.cpp and other files: comment-only Doxygen @file/@author headers added, no code changes

decisions.rationale: Edits only the comment headers of the EMP pump source files, replacing the adaptation note with an author line and removing a provenance paragraph. The EMP pump protocol, configuration, and runtime behavior are unchanged, so no documentation or user action follows.
evidence: firmware/controllers/modules/emp_pump/emp_pump.cpp: header comment reduced to @file and @author lines
firmware/controllers/modules/emp_pump/emp_pump.h: removed Speeduino commit reference and 'native FOME adaptation' sentence from the header comment
No changes to EmpPumpConfig, CAN IDs, or state machine code
